parts.text: Explain the main principles behind the use of ultrasound to obtain diagnostic information about internal body structures.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text:
Two media have specific acoustic impedances of $Z_1$ and $Z_2$.

The magnitudes of the acoustic impedances may be almost equal or very different. State how these differences affect the intensity reflection coefficient at the boundary between the two media.

$Z_1 \approx Z_2$ ......................................................

$Z_1 \gg Z_2$ or $Z_1 \ll Z_2$ ......................................................
